about:
Micro Mold Plastics USA, Inc. operates from Fort Worth, Texas. The current woman-owned entity began production in March 2018 under president Lisa K. Allison, though its lineage traces back to Micro Molding Inc. in the 1960s and Micro Mold Plastics Inc., established in 1987.

The company specializes in small, close-tolerance injection molding from a 20,000-square-foot facility equipped with presses ranging from 25 to 240 tons. Core processes include injection molding, close-tolerance molding, sonic welding, and hot stamping, supported by in-house testing and inspection.

Micro Mold Plastics serves customers requiring precision plastic components, with its AS9100D certification and DDTC registration indicating work in aerospace and defense markets. The firm emphasizes quality parts and superior customer service, drawing on a combined 120-plus years of industry experience among its team.

Founded to provide quality parts paired with responsive service, the company leverages its deep plastics heritage and certified quality system to meet tight-tolerance demands.
